created_prompt:
Create a concise three year plan for Julie, a cooking creator with 1.2M followers, who creates food recipes.

Julie works four days a week with limited time, and wants to publish a cookbook. Julie is unsure about traditional vs self publishing, 

Include goals and milestones for each year or biannual. Provide a description of traditional vs self publishing. 

Recommend the best option for Julie and explain why. Have realistic plans and goals for her timeline and budget.
